_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro: {num_players}-Onye na-egwu egwu agwọ na {width}×{height} grid. Ị na-achịkwa agwọ {player_id}. Mgbanwe ndị dị irè: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ma ọ bụ w / s / a / d). Ebumnuche: lanarị ogologo oge ma ọ bụ bụrụ onye kachasị ogologo ma nweta akara kachasị elu (ntụgharị ntụgharị {max_turns}).

game_action.invalid_death: Agwọ {player_id} nwụrụ n'ihi ngagharị na-abaghị uru.

outcome.outlived: Onye na-egwu egwu dị ndụ karịa ndị ọzọ niile.
outcome.turn_limit: E ruola oke ntụgharị - onye kacha nwee akara ga-emeri tie-break.
